About this item

  • DURABLE & ODOR-FREE FABRIC: Made from premium 1680D waterproof Nylon Oxford, FURHAB dog poop bag holder is thicker and built to last. Unlike cheap plastic holders, it won't emit unpleasant smells or create noise, making daily walks more enjoyable
  • CONVENIENT & CUTE DESIGN: Featuring a bone-shaped rubber opening, this poop bag dispenser allows you to pull out bags one by one while keeping the rest securely in place. Functional and stylish, it makes grabbing a bag during walks quick and hassle-free
  • HEAVY-DUTY CARABINER CLIP: Equipped with a scratch-resistant metal carabiner, the doggy bag holder easily attaches to leashes, belts, backpacks or keyrings. It's sturdier than regular ones and retains its shine even after prolonged outdoor use
  • FITS MOST POOP BAGS: The soft doggie poop bag holder is compatible with most standard pet waste bag rolls, so you can use up your existing bag stash without worry. Simply refill with your preferred bags whenever needed for everyday convenience
  • READY-TO-USE SET: Includes a lightweight poop bag carrier (2.95" x 1.77") and 1 roll of 15 dog poop bags, so you can start right away. Perfect for walking, running, hiking or traveling with your dog while keeping trash bags organized, clean and always within reach
